VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the report claims the root cause was identified and all 71 tests pass, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports lack the objectivity needed to confirm that the fix was actually implemented correctly and that the full test suite genuinely passes.
